Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

An enigmatic cult of necromancers, the Harbingers of Skulls joined the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} relatively recently. Nearly all members are of considerable age, having spent long unlives studying death and the rites that command it before allying with the Sword of Caine.

Disciplines: Auspex, Fortitude, Necromancy

Advantage: At character creation and at no extra cost, a Harbinger of Skulls may take any combination of three of the following: Sabbat @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference.JournalEntry.St7uVm2DqK4nRy8X]{Status}, an Influence, or a trivial boon.

Disadvantage: Every Harbinger bears the Negative Social Traits Ghastly x3 whenever their true, corpse-like form is revealed - these Traits cannot be removed, though Obfuscate can hide them. Harbingers may never possess appearance-related Traits such as Gorgeous or Seductive, and they cannot initiate Social Challenges, though they may defend against them normally.

Organization: Harbingers of Skulls keep to their own necromantic circles and rites, contributing arcane knowledge of death to the sect while remaining aloof from typical pack life.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat} - the antitribu designation itself marks this bloodline's members as having sided with the Sabbat rather than the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}.
